sections.title: Aerospace Engineering Documentation RAG
sections.description: For Lockheed Martin Space (Littleton), United Launch Alliance (Centennial), and the Space Corridor's engineering community.

blocks.heading: Technical specification knowledge RAG
paragraphs: Self-hosted RAG over Lockheed's and ULA's engineering documentation — technical specifications, system design documents, and test reports — enabling engineers to ask natural language questions about system requirements, interface definitions, and design decisions from the vast documentation that complex aerospace programs generate. A single satellite program can generate millions of pages of documentation over its development lifecycle; RAG makes this institutional knowledge queryable.

blocks.heading: Parts and component knowledge RAG
paragraphs: RAG over aerospace parts databases, approved supplier lists, and qualification documentation for the Space Corridor's procurement and supply chain teams — natural language query of component specifications, alternative suppliers, and qualification requirements for the thousands of aerospace-grade parts in a spacecraft's bill of materials.

blocks.heading: Lessons learned RAG
paragraphs: RAG over post-project review documentation, anomaly reports, and engineering lessons learned for aerospace engineering teams designing new programs — preventing recurrence of historical engineering problems by making lessons learned queryable rather than archival.
All aerospace RAG: self-hosted Llama 3 on corporate infrastructure — zero IP leaves the Space Corridor.

sections.title: Energy Regulatory Knowledge RAG
sections.description: For Xcel Energy (Denver HQ) and Colorado's oil, gas, and utility community.

blocks.heading: FERC and NERC standards RAG
paragraphs: RAG over FERC electric tariffs, NERC reliability standards, and Colorado PUC orders for Xcel Energy's regulatory affairs and grid operations teams — enabling staff to query the thousands of pages of regulatory requirements that govern Xcel's transmission and distribution operations in natural language rather than manual search.

blocks.heading: COGCC regulation RAG
paragraphs: RAG over Colorado Oil and Gas Conservation Commission regulations, permits, and guidance for the Denver Basin operators — enabling landmen, engineers, and compliance staff to query Colorado's oil and gas regulatory framework in natural language as regulations evolve under Colorado's SB 181 framework.

blocks.heading: Renewable energy interconnection RAG
paragraphs: RAG over FERC interconnection procedures, MISO tariff requirements, and Colorado interconnection standards for the solar and wind developers managing interconnection applications through Colorado's grid.

sections.title: Healthcare Clinical Knowledge RAG
sections.description: For UCHealth, Centura/Intermountain Colorado, and Denver's health systems.

blocks.heading: Altitude-aware clinical guideline RAG
paragraphs: RAG over clinical practice guidelines with Colorado altitude-specific adjustments — UCHealth's clinical staff can query evidence-based guidelines and receive answers calibrated to Denver's 5,280-foot elevation where pulmonary, cardiac, and hematological reference ranges differ from sea-level norms. UCHealth has published on altitude medicine and physiological adaptation; ClickMasters indexes this institutional knowledge alongside standard guidelines.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act-compliant clinical RAG
paragraphs: Clinical RAG in Colorado that supports clinical decision-making may constitute a high-risk AI system under Colorado's SB24-205 — ClickMasters designs Denver clinical RAG with Colorado AI Act impact assessment as a standard deliverable.

blocks.heading: Population health protocol RAG
paragraphs: RAG over UCHealth's and Centura's care management protocols and disease management guidelines for their population health teams.

sections.title: Colorado Law and Government Knowledge RAG
sections.description: For Denver law firms and Colorado state agencies.

blocks.heading: Colorado statutes and regulations RAG
paragraphs: RAG over Colorado Revised Statutes, Colorado Code of Regulations, and Attorney General opinions for Denver's legal community — enabling attorneys and compliance officers to query Colorado's regulatory framework in natural language.

blocks.heading: Cannabis regulatory RAG (Colorado MED)
paragraphs: RAG over Colorado Marijuana Enforcement Division regulations, Metrc seed-to-sale system documentation, and local cannabis licensing requirements for the cannabis technology companies building compliance platforms for Colorado's mature cannabis industry.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted as aerospace standard
paragraphs: ClickMasters deploys all aerospace RAG on client infrastructure — Lockheed and ULA engineering documentation cannot be transmitted to external LLM APIs. Llama 3 70B self-hosted on corporate cloud infrastructure is the default Denver aerospace RAG deployment.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act for clinical RAG
paragraphs: Denver healthcare RAG that supports clinical decision-making requires Colorado AI Act impact assessment. ClickMasters delivers this documentation as a standard component of Denver healthcare RAG engagements.

blocks.heading: Altitude-calibrated medical knowledge
paragraphs: Denver's healthcare RAG knowledge bases incorporate altitude-specific clinical parameters that standard national clinical guideline databases don't include — ClickMasters sources and indexes Colorado-specific clinical guidance as a differentiator for Denver healthcare RAG.
